props.name: accessibilityLabel

props.name: size

props.name: name

props.name: src

props.name: title

props.name: variant
props.doc: Surface style. Defaults to normal.

props.name: columns

props.name: bordered

props.name: value

props.name: span

components.name: DescriptionSeparator
components.doc: A full-width divider between DescriptionList rows.

components.doc: One entry in a Breadcrumb.

props.name: label
props.doc: Entry text.

props.name: disabled

props.name: value
props.doc: Text copied when clicked.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Tooltip shown on hover.

props.name: tooltipDelay
props.doc: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers.

components.name: Checkbox

props.name: label
props.doc: Text beside the box.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the box is checked.

props.name: defaultChecked

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disabled boxes ignore clicks.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Tooltip shown on hover.

props.doc: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

components.name: Switch

props.name: label
props.doc: Text beside the switch.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Whether the switch is on.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: Initial state when `checked` is unset; the control then keeps its own state, like an uncontrolled React input.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disabled switches ignore clicks.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Tooltip shown on hover.

props.name: tooltipDelay
props.doc: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers when it differs from the label.

props.name: tabIndex
props.doc: Keyboard focus order.

props.name: tabStop
props.doc: False skips the control when tabbing. Defaults to true.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size. Defaults to medium.

props.name: color
props.doc: Track color when on: a theme color name or #rrggbb.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.doc: A single-choice group. Children are Radio elements; selection is by index.

props.name: selected
props.doc: Index of the selected Radio, or -1 for none.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.doc: Initial selected index when `selected` is unset; the group then keeps its own selection.

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Stacks options vertically. Defaults to horizontal.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables every option.

components.name: Radio
components.doc: One option in a RadioGroup; also usable standalone with checked and onChange.

props.name: label
props.doc: Option text.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Selected state of a standalone radio. Inside a RadioGroup, the group's selected index wins.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: Initial state when `checked` is unset; the control then keeps its own state, like an uncontrolled React input.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disabled options cannot be chosen.

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Tooltip shown on hover.

props.name: tooltipDelay
props.doc: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Name read by screen readers when it differs from the label.

props.name: tabIndex
props.doc: Keyboard focus order.

props.name: tabStop
props.doc: False skips the control when tabbing. Defaults to true.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size. Defaults to medium.

events.doc: Receives true when a standalone radio is chosen.

components.doc: A button that stays pressed while on. Use a label, an icon or both.

props.name: label
props.doc: Text.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon.

props.name: checked
props.doc: Pressed (on) state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.doc: Initial state when `checked` is unset; the control then keeps its own state, like an uncontrolled React input.

props.name: disabled

props.name: tooltip
props.doc: Tooltip shown on hover.

props.name: tooltipDelay
props.doc: Milliseconds before the tooltip appears.

components.name: Rating
components.doc: A star rating input.

props.name: value
props.doc: Number of filled stars.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: Initial rating when `value` is unset; the rating then keeps its own value.

props.name: max
props.doc: Total stars. Defaults to 5.

props.name: disabled

props.name: color
props.doc: Star color: a theme color name or #rrggbb.

props.name: size

components.name: Pagination
components.doc: Page navigation buttons. Pages are numbered from 1.

props.name: page
props.doc: Current page (1-based), controlled; set it from onChange. Without it the pagination keeps its own page.

props.name: defaultPage
props.doc: Initial page when `page` is unset. Defaults to 1.

props.name: total
props.doc: Number of pages.

props.name: compact
props.doc: Shows only previous and next buttons with the page count.

props.name: visiblePages
props.doc: Most page buttons shown before ellipses.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Ignores clicks.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size: xsmall, small, medium (default) or large.

components.name: Slider
components.doc: A draggable numeric slider.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value (or a range's start), controlled; set it from onChange. Without it the slider keeps its own value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: Initial value when `value` is unset.

props.name: range
props.doc: Two thumbs: value is the start and endValue the end. Read when it mounts.

props.name: endValue
props.doc: A range's end, controlled; set it from onEndChange.

props.name: defaultEndValue
props.doc: A range's initial end.

props.name: min
props.doc: Smallest value. Defaults to 0.

props.name: max
props.doc: Largest value. Defaults to 100.

props.name: step
props.doc: Increment. Defaults to 1.

props.name: scale
props.doc: Value spacing along the track; logarithmic suits volumes and frequencies.

props.name: vertical
props.doc: A vertical track; give it a height.

props.name: reverse
props.doc: Runs from max to min.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Ignores input.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: Names the slider for assistive technology.

props.name: selected
props.doc: The current step index, controlled; set it from onChange. Without it the stepper keeps its own step.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.doc: Initial step when `selected` is unset.

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Stacks the steps vertically.

props.name: textCenter
props.doc: Centers labels under their markers.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables every step.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size: xsmall, small, medium (default) or large.

props.name: label

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Cannot be selected.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size: xsmall, small, medium (default) or large.

components.name: Tabs
components.doc: A row of Tab triggers that switches between TabsContent panels.

props.name: value
props.doc: The selected tab's value, controlled; set it from onChange. Without it the tabs keep their own selection.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: Initially selected tab value when `value` is unset. Defaults to the first tab.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Tab style: tab (default), underline, pill, outline, segmented or folder (browser-style tabs that join the content below).

props.name: menu

props.name: maxWidth

props.name: size
props.doc: Tab size: xsmall, small, medium (default) or large.

components.name: Accordion

props.doc: Open item values, one per line, controlled; set it from onChange. Without it the accordion keeps its own open items.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: Initially open item values, one per line, when `value` is unset.

props.name: multiple
props.doc: Lets several items stay open; otherwise opening one closes the others.

props.name: bordered
props.doc: false removes the outer border. Defaults to true.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables every item.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size: xsmall, small, medium (default) or large.

events.doc: Runs with the open item values after each toggle.

components.name: Select
components.doc: A button that opens a list of options and shows the chosen one. Options come from SelectItem children (optionally inside SelectGroup) or the items prop.

props.name: items
props.doc: Plain options whose label is also the value; SelectItem children add more.

props.name: value
props.doc: The selected option's value, controlled; set it from onChange. Without it the select keeps its own selection.

props.name: defaultValue
props.doc: Initially selected value when `value` is unset.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Text shown while nothing is selected.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Ignores clicks and keys.

props.name: searchable
props.doc: Adds a search field that filters the options. Read when the select mounts.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.doc: Hint in the search field.

props.name: cleanable
props.doc: Shows a clear button while an option is selected; clearing reports an empty value.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon in place of the dropdown caret.

props.name: titlePrefix
props.doc: Text before the selected label, such as "Country: ".

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.doc: A name that stays the same as the selection changes.

props.name: appearance
props.doc: false draws the bare trigger without border and background.

props.name: menuWidth
props.doc: Width of the open list in pixels. Defaults to the trigger's width.

props.name: menuMaxHeight
props.doc: Most height in pixels the open list takes before it scrolls.

props.name: scrollBounce
props.doc: Elastic overscroll in the list. Defaults to the platform's behavior.

props.name: autoFocus
props.doc: Focuses the select when it mounts.

props.name: size
props.doc: Control size: xsmall, small, medium (default) or large.

events.doc: Runs with the chosen value, or empty when cleared.

Synchronous pure predicate for nonempty candidate text. Return false to reject an edit; the empty string always remains valid so the field can be cleared. Runs in addition to the mask and pattern. Reads captured signals live; do not issue UI commands or mutate state during validation.

components.name: AppMenuBar
components.doc: Installs the application menus. macOS displays them in the system menu bar; Windows and Linux render the Kit menu bar here. Declare one in the main window. Changed labels, checked/disabled flags and children reload automatically. Hiding or removing the owning menu bar removes its installed menus. MenuItem entries require text and a Shortcut command; the active window handles that command. Missing commands disable an item. props.name: softWrap

props.name: searchable

props.name: scrollBounce
props.doc: Enables elastic overscroll. Omission keeps the Kit default.

props.name: wrappingIndent

props.name: tabSize

components.doc: A read-only, virtualized view of a unified or Git patch, with one section per changed file. Display and context props preserve the retained comparison state; mode changes can reset horizontal scrolling and context changes can adjust folded rows. Changing patch replaces the parsed files. Invalid patch text reports its parse line and message and stops the application. For example, <Diff patch={patch} mode="split" softWrap={true}/> wraps both source columns. Callbacks receive retained JSON snapshots with file paths and one-based source positions. Ownership: the mounted node owns one comparison state; callbacks retain weak window owners.

props.name: softWrap
props.doc: Wraps long source lines within the view. Defaults to false; horizontal scrolling preserves source lines.

props.name: contextLines

props.name: expansionLines

components.name: SpeechButton
components.doc: A microphone button that dictates with the system speech recognizer (macOS and Windows). Click to start; click again to stop and receive the final transcript. Locale, systemFallback and stopTimeout are read once when mounted; disabled, size and waveform presentation can change without restarting the recognizer. Unsupported hosts hide the button unless showWhenUnsupported is true. Each mounted button owns its recognizer and releases capture when disposed.

props.name: locale
props.doc: BCP 47 language such as en-US or fr-FR. Defaults to the system language.

props.name: waveform
props.doc: Shows the input level beside the button while listening.

props.name: size
props.doc: Button and waveform size; medium by default.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables button interaction; false by default. Does not stop an already running session.

props.name: showWhenUnsupported
props.doc: Shows a disabled microphone when no recognizer is available, instead of hiding it. Defaults to false.

props.name: systemFallback
props.doc: Whether to use the system recognizer. Defaults to true. false leaves this button unsupported, even with locale set. Read once at mount.

props.name: stopTimeout
props.doc: Nonnegative milliseconds to wait for a final transcript after stopping, then finish with the transcript so far. Defaults to 3000. Read once at mount; negative values throw before mounting.

props.name: waveformStyle
props.doc: Waveform appearance while capturing; bars by default. Requires waveform=true.

events.doc: Receives the whole transcript so far while the user speaks.
Receives the final transcript when the session ends; it may be empty.
Receives a readable message when recognition fails, such as denied microphone access.
Called when a session starts capturing audio.
Called if the recognizer session is explicitly cancelled and its transcript discarded. Stopping normally, including its timeout, calls onFinal instead.

components.name: Plot
components.doc: A custom chart over shared category labels: layer PlotLine, PlotArea and PlotBars marks on one value scale, with optional axis labels and grid.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Category labels along the x axis, one per value.

props.name: axis
props.doc: Draws the x axis with labels. Defaults to false.

props.name: grid
props.doc: Draws dashed horizontal grid lines. Defaults to false.

components.children: PlotLine, PlotArea, PlotBars and an optional PlotTooltip
components.example: <Plot labels={['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4']} axis={true} grid={true} className="h-64"><PlotBars values={[4, 6, 5, 8]}/><PlotLine values={[3, 5, 6, 7]} curve="linear" dots={true}/></Plot>

components.name: PlotTooltip
components.doc: A hover overlay for its parent Plot. The pointer chooses the nearest category band; automatic rows show each available series value. Uses the plot’s stable identity and releases hover state with the plot. No tooltip is shown for an empty plot or over axis labels.

props.name: glide
props.doc: Glides crosshair and dots between categories. Defaults to true; false snaps to the category.

props.name: progress
props.doc: Optional overlay opacity, clamped to 0–1. Must be finite. Omit to use Kit’s hover fade.

props.name: title
props.doc: Overrides the category label shown as the title. Omit to show the hovered label; an empty string hides the title.

props.name: showSeries
props.doc: Includes a colored row for each series value at the hovered category. Defaults to true. Short series omit missing values.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Nonnegative finite spacing in logical pixels between the pointer and tooltip box, at most the native float maximum. Defaults to 8; invalid values throw a UI error.

props.name: crossLine
props.doc: Crosshair direction. Defaults to vertical. Its data coordinate follows the category center and pointer height.

props.name: dots
props.doc: Draws a colored dot at each available series value. Defaults to true.

props.name: appearance
props.doc: Shows the tooltip box background, border and shadow. Defaults to true. Crosshair and dots remain when false.

components.name: PlotTooltipRow
components.doc: An extra row in PlotTooltip, after automatic series rows. Values are application supplied; a row without color aligns with series rows without drawing a swatch.

props.name: label
props.doc: Row label, empty by default.

props.name: value
props.doc: Displayed value, empty by default. Signal expressions update live.

props.name: color
props.doc: Optional swatch color: a theme or Tailwind palette color, or #rrggbb. Omit for a plain row.

props.name: valueColor
props.doc: Optional text color for this row’s value. Uses the same color names as Plot marks; omit to inherit tooltip text color.

components.name: PlotLine
components.doc: A line through one value per Plot label.

props.name: values
props.doc: Finite numbers, in label order. NaN and infinities throw a UI error. Missing trailing values are omitted; extra values beyond the labels are not drawn.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color (chart-1 … chart-5, primary, destructive, foreground, muted-foreground) or #rrggbb. Defaults to the next chart color.

props.name: curve
props.doc: Smooth (default), straight segments, or steps.

props.name: dots
props.doc: Marks each point with a dot.

props.name: width
props.doc: Nonnegative finite stroke width in logical pixels, at most the native float maximum. Defaults to 2; invalid values throw a UI error.

props.name: label
props.doc: Series name in PlotTooltip. Defaults to Series 1, Series 2, and so on in mark order.
